data.notes: Confirmed October 2026 music programming is still sparse, with Savaya’s electronic bookings providing the main destination-scale anchors so far.

events.title: Zamna Bali 2026 at Savaya
events.summary: Savaya confirms Zamna returns to Bali for two shows on October 17–18, 2026. The Tulum-origin electronic festival brand brings its international club-festival concept to the Uluwatu venue.

events.title: Hayden James at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Australian electronic artist Hayden James is confirmed for a Halloween-night headline set at Savaya Bali on October 31, 2026. The official Savaya event page lists doors at 3:00 PM.

events.title: Boat Vibes Bali Vol. 4
events.venueName: The Shivanna - Benoa Check In Point
events.summary: Boat Vibes Bali Vol. 4 is a confirmed sunset cruise from Benoa Harbour on October 10, 2026, billed with a live DJ and fire dance. The itinerary runs as a four-hour sailing event along the Nusa Dua coastline.

events.title: Shivanna Halloween Party
events.venueName: The Shivanna - Benoa Check In Point
events.summary: The Shivanna Halloween Party is confirmed for October 31, 2026, as a sunset cruise from Benoa Harbour. The ticket page lists a live DJ, fire dance, canapés, and a four-hour sailing format.
